tickets.title: Reduce Datadog alert noise — P3/P4 threshold tuning

tickets.title: Race condition in session invalidation on concurrent logout

comments.author: arjun.mehta
comments.body: Reproduced. Issue is in the Redis TTL eviction order during concurrent DEL calls.

comments.author: arjun.mehta
comments.body: Fix ready. Using Lua script for atomic DEL+check. Need Priya to review Redis changes.

comments.author: priya.nair
comments.body: Lua script looks correct. Approved.

tickets.blocker_reason: Waiting on Redis expert review (Priya on PTO)

tickets.title: Memory leak in API gateway under sustained load

comments.author: david.kim
comments.body: Heap profiling shows unclosed gzip streams. Every request that accepts compressed response leaks ~2KB.

comments.author: david.kim
comments.body: Fix: always close GZIPOutputStream in finally block. Load tested at 10K RPM for 30min — stable.

comments.author: marcus.lee
comments.body: Memory usage flat at 512MB sustained. Confirmed fix.
